mapper.select: SELECT uns.user_email AS userEmail FROM user_notification_setting uns WHERE uns.recommendation_enabled = 1

SELECT p.place_id AS placeId, p.place_name AS placeName, p.category AS category, p.address AS address, COALESCE(AVG(pr.rating), 0) AS averageRating, COUNT(pr.id) AS reviewCount FROM place p LEFT JOIN place_review pr ON pr.place_id = p.place_id WHERE p.category = #{category} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM place_review mypr WHERE mypr.useremail = #{userEmail} AND mypr.place_id = p.place_id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_notification un WHERE un.user_email = #{userEmail} AND un.notification_type = 'RECOMMENDATION' AND un.target_id = p.place_id AND un.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ) GROUP BY p.place_id, p.place_name, p.category, p.address HAVING COUNT(pr.id) >= 1 ORDER BY averageRating DESC, reviewCount DESC LIMIT 5
